reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically problematic: Pt is an FCC stabilizer and strongly partitions to the FCC phase, making L1₀-type ordering in an FeCoNiPt FCC matrix highly unlikely under the proposed conditions; the cited prior FeCoNiPt work showed soft ferromagnetism, not ordering-induced coercivity.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion (10× coercivity increase and L1₀ superlattice reflections), making it experimentally feasible.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a mechanism (L1₀ ordering in an FCC matrix) that contradicts well-established phase stability in this system, so testing it would not advance the field.
